exercises.why: **проводим** — проводи́ть (imperfective): to spend (time), to pass; (electricity) to conduct; to conduct, to lead, to guide; to carry out, to carry through, to realize, to put into practice, to conduct. Wiktionary: про- + води́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **продал** — прода́ть (perfective): to sell; to sell out, to betray. Wiktionary: про- + дать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: просну́ться — to awake, to wake up; проводи́ть — to spend (time), to pass; протяну́ть — to stretch, to extend; произнести́ — to pronounce, to articulate.
**прожить** — прожи́ть (perfective): to live, to outlast; to reside (for some time); (transitive) to spend, to run through. Wiktionary: про- + жить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: He won't live a long life.
